$comment: Saved tanks ("Bể của tôi") test cases, shared by the site (packages/schema/test/tanks.test.ts) and the iOS app. Schema: packages/schema/src/tanks.ts (JSON Schema: protocols/tanks.schema.json). Merge rules: docs/my-tanks-sync.md. valid: decodes, and encodes back to the same JSON (unknown keys kept). invalid: refused; path is one of the paths the site's validator reports (other implementations need only refuse). invalidUnlisted: empty, since the iOS app reads a tank's entries without a page (`unlisted`): their cases are in invalid now; an app that keeps the field as an unknown key passes the valid ones. merge: mergeRecords(kept, incoming). mergeStores: the same per list. stamp: the updatedAt a change gets. Bluetooth names and plugs' remote ids are synthetic.

valid.note: a new tank: only the required fields
a tank with everything
a round tank: litres from the volume tool, no box dimensions
a substrate value this client does not know yet
a field from a newer client is kept as it is
a fish and a plant the handbook has no page for yet: the fish with its scientific name and count, the plant by name only
an entry without a page of a kind this client does not know yet, with a key it does not know
an entry without a page: a name of 80 characters, a scientific name of 120
a Chihiros light with one saved schedule
a light with manual levels, a clock sync and the active schedule
a white-only light: one level
a schedule that ends at midnight (00:00)
a ramp of exactly half the time lit
a device kind this client does not know yet, without schedules
unknown keys inside a device: its schedules, its manual levels
a light plugged into an outlet of a strip on its tank, with a key this client does not know
a Tuya strip with its outlets named on the tank
an outlet role this client does not know yet
an eWeLink switch, no outlet named yet
a Week Aqua light: its address, its timer as the one schedule written last, the levels as sent
a Week Aqua timer that ends past midnight: kept with what was sent, not as a schedule
unknown keys inside a tank: dims, species, plants
a padded name is kept as written (writers trim; readers do not)
a name of 80 characters
a name of 80 emoji: lengths count Unicode code points (Swift unicodeScalars.count), not UTF-16 units
a leap day
a tombstone keeps a key it does not know
a tombstone
an empty store
a store with a tank, its light and a deleted tank

invalid.note: an uppercase id (Swift UUID().uuidString must be lowercased)
a timestamp with an offset instead of Z
a species by its Vietnamese name instead of its page id
a live tank with deletedAt (tombstones carry nothing else)
a ramp longer than half the time lit
a plug outlet without its code
a Bluetooth address on a plug
a light's outlet named by the maker's device id, not the plug's record id
a light's outlet without its code
a store with the same tank twice
null for a key that may be left out (leave it out instead)
a tombstone without deletedAt is a tank without a name
an entry without a page and without a name
an entry without a page with a blank name
an entry without a page and without its kind
an entry without a page with an uppercase id
an entry without a page counting 0 fish
a blank scientific name (leave it out instead)
null for the entries without a page (leave the key out when there are none)
more than 100 entries without a page

merge.note: records only one side has are kept, sorted by id
the same updatedAt: the copy already kept stays
a later delete removes the record
an edit made after the delete brings the record back
an older edit does not bring a deleted record back
the same updatedAt: a tombstone wins over a live copy
the same updatedAt: a kept tombstone stays over an incoming live copy
an id twice in one list: every copy goes through the rule in order (later updatedAt wins)
an id twice with the same updatedAt: the first copy stays
an id twice with the same updatedAt, one deleted: the tombstone wins wherever it is

mergeStores.note: tanks and devices merge on their own: the newer tank from one side, the newer device from the other

stamp.note: the copy is from later than this clock: just after it
the copy is from this very millisecond: just after it
